tiktok.caption: 73% start January $1,500 in debt — from Christmas. Here's the holiday trap nobody talks about and how to break it.

youtube_short.title: 73% Start January $1,500 in Holiday Debt
title_alternatives: The Holiday Debt Trap Nobody Warns You About
Why You're Still Paying for Christmas in April
youtube_short.description: Every holiday season, 73% of Americans swipe their way into an average of $1,463 in debt — and don't pay it off until April. It's not about being generous, it's a psychology trap retailers spend billions engineering every single year. The fix is deceptively simple: set your gift budget BEFORE you open a shopping app, not after. Families who do this keep an extra $410 per person in their pocket. Follow for a new money psychology breakdown every day. #holidaydebt #personalfinance #moneytips #christmasdebt #savemoney
